name: Kuang-Chi Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Kuang-Chi Technologies Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of metamaterial cutting-edge equipment products in China. It serves railway, shipbuilding, aerospace, and other transportation equipment manufacturing industries. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Longsheng Auto Parts Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kuang-Chi Technologies Co., Ltd. in June 2017. Kuang-Chi Technologies Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
